children: Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:LCID) moved to preserve cash with a $1.4B restructuring and says roughly $3B liquidity now extends runway into 2027, even as a 27,185‑vehicle recall, a senior finance exit, a wiped leveraged ETF and proposed 50% auto tariffs threaten costs, margins and timelines.
Lucid Group, Inc. Restructuring To Boost Liquidity
: Lucid (LCID) launched a $1.4B restructuring to cut capex, reduce staff and boost working capital. Company reports about $3B liquidity and says actions extend runway into 2027.
: Lucid (LCID) recalls 27,185 Lucid Airs (2022–2026) over overheating exterior lighting circuit and fire risk. OTA software eFuse fix issued; 20,700+ cars updated. Owners told to park outside.
Tariffs Could Raise Lucid Production Costs
: U.S. proposal for 50% tariffs on foreign auto imports and parts could raise Lucid Group (LCID) production costs, squeeze margins and delay timelines — key risks for traders to monitor.
: GraniteShares liquidated its 2x leveraged ETF tied to Lucid Group (LCID) after LCID plunged about 51% on July 14, wiping the ETF’s NAV to zero and prompting fund wind-down and asset liquidation.
Lucid SVP Finance Gagan Dhingra Departs
: Lucid Group (LCID) said SVP of Finance Gagan Dhingra will depart effective Aug 14, 2026. Company disclosed the date but gave no successor, interim coverage, or financial terms.
